{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows sustained negative sentiment (e.g., multiple -0.25 or 0.00 values) indicating bearish momentum.",
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes by applying a 10-15% downward correction to the immediate next period.",
    "When sentiment history includes a recent +0.50 or higher, increase forecast sensitivity to mean reversion by applying a 5-10% upward adjustment to the 30-day average.",
    "For periods with low sentiment volatility (e.g., all 0.00), apply a conservative mean reversion correction: forecast = 0.95 * previous period + 0.05 * true outcome.",
    "If true outcome consistently exceeds forecast by >5% over 3 consecutive days, apply a downward bias correction of 2-3% to the next forecast horizon.",
    "In cases where model overestimates early in the 30-day horizon (e.g., first 5 days), reduce forecast by 3-5% to account for lagged market reaction.",
    "When sentiment history includes a recent +0.67 or higher, anticipate bullish momentum and apply a 5-8% upward bias to the forecast, especially in the first 7 days."
  ]
}
